ec72001c-45fe-45c7-996a-c42de66aa218.quote: Cuban Noobster's Scarlett was a bloody mess: hero damage under a third of her usual, dead before two of their three Fangtooths. When Fangtooth is close and Yurei is not visible, Scarlett stays alive near the pit or takes a tower elsewhere. Her last death came with no kill trade around it, right before both inhibitors and the Core went. She still led our objective damage and took the Riktor kill at Primal Fangtooth.
ec72001c-45fe-45c7-996a-c42de66aa218.issue: generic 'stays alive' takeaway; Yurei condition does not match the Fangtooth deaths, which were to Sparrow and Ikra

Mr_Meat31 still handled the healer half: solid healing, no deaths before minute 10, and a hand in just under half our kills.

ec72001c-45fe-45c7-996a-c42de66aa218.quote: Duo lane against Sparrow and Riktor. Riktor is a catch support built around pull, silence and suppress, and he finished with the most damage mitigated in the match. Phase is a link enchanter with low mobility. The enemy drafted no healers, so Phase's ally healing was a tool they lacked, though Yurei's self-healing still topped the match.

ec72001c-45fe-45c7-996a-c42de66aa218.quote: Prophecy adds magic damage on basic attacks and Orion converts item ability haste into attack speed and amplifies on-hit damage, which pushes Phase toward basic-attack damage. Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage and was our only magical anti-heal, against Terminus on Grux and Ikra and Yurei's match-high healing. Galaxy Greaves adds out-of-combat movement speed. The support core's Marshal and Enra's Blessing were skipped; Enra's shields an immobilized ally nearby, which is the exact Riktor case.
